title: Gail and the Market with No Prices
chineseTitle: 瑜瑜與沒有價錢的魔法市集

scenes.title: A golden token

C: A small gold token rolls across the bedroom floor and stops beside Gail’s cream slipper.
She waits until it is still before touching it.
一枚小金代幣滾過臥室地板，停在瑜瑜的奶油白拖鞋旁。
她等它停穩才伸手。

scenes.title: A market doorway

C: Only after the token rests does a ring of golden light spread across the floor.
A doorway to a busy market opens, and Gail steps through.
代幣停穩後，金光才沿地板擴散。
通往熱鬧市集的門打開，瑜瑜走了進去。

scenes.title: A busy market

C: Beneath the colorful awnings, Gail visits a fruit shop and a food stall selling beef, pork, rice, and fresh salad.
Customers carry baskets along the stone path while the workers call out friendly greetings.
彩色布棚下，瑜瑜逛了水果店，也看見賣牛肉、豬肉、白飯和新鮮沙拉的餐點攤。
顧客提著籃子走過石路，攤主親切地招呼大家。

scenes.title: Blank price cards

C: A gust sweeps the price cards from their hooks and scatters them across the stalls.
The fruit remains in place, but nobody can see what it costs.
一陣風把價牌從掛鉤吹走，散落攤間。
水果還在原位，卻沒有人看得出價格。

scenes.C_original_string: A gust sweeps the price cards from their hooks and scatters them across the stalls.|The fruit remains in place, but nobody can see what it costs.

scenes.title: Too much or too little

C: A customer holds a basket of fruit in one hand and money in the other.
Without its price card, he cannot tell whether his offer is too much or too little.
顧客一手拿水果籃，一手拿錢。
少了價牌，他無法知道自己提出的金額是太多還是太少。

scenes.title: The worried worker

C: The worker returns the coin to the tray instead of guessing a price.
“I want this trade to be fair to both of us,” she tells the customer.
攤主把代幣放回托盤，不願隨意猜價。
她告訴顧客：「我希望這筆交易對我們雙方都公平。」

scenes.title: A clue on the table

C: On the worktable, Gail discovers the original order, a picture note showing fruit and their amounts.
Several loose price cards lie partly hidden beneath it.
瑜瑜在工作桌找到原始訂單，上面畫著水果與份量。
幾張散落的價牌半掩在訂單下。

scenes.title: Find the missing cards

C: Gail checks below the awning while the worker looks beside the fruit baskets.
They gather each scattered card before deciding where it belongs.
瑜瑜查看布棚下方，攤主搜尋果籃旁。
她們先撿齊每張卡片，再決定它該掛在哪裡。

scenes.title: Match the fruit

C: One card shows round red fruit, just like the apples in the basket.
Gail places it nearby but asks the worker to check before hanging it.
一張卡片畫著圓圓的紅色水果，和籃中蘋果相同。
瑜瑜先把卡片放在旁邊，請攤主確認後才掛上。

scenes.title: Check the order

C: The picture order shows how many pieces belong in this basket.
Gail counts them one by one, then checks that the card names the same amount.
圖像訂單標出這籃該有幾顆水果。
瑜瑜逐一點數，再確認價牌標示相同份量。

scenes.title: Ask the customer

C: Rather than deciding for him, Gail asks the customer which basket he picked.
She listens until he finishes and points to the matching picture.
瑜瑜沒有替顧客做決定，而是問他選了哪一籃。
她聽完他的回答，再指向相符的圖片。

scenes.title: Ask the worker

C: The worker compares the card with her original order and confirms the amount and fruit.
Only then does she return it to its hook.
攤主拿價牌對照原始訂單，確認水果和份量。
這時她才把卡片掛回原來的鉤子。

scenes.title: One card is wrong

C: Gail pauses before hanging a second card.
Although its color looks similar, the fruit shape does not match the basket beneath it.
瑜瑜在掛第二張卡片前停下來。
雖然顏色相近，水果形狀卻和下方籃子不符。

scenes.title: Compare carefully

C: The worker, customer, and Gail compare the two cards side by side, careful not to call one cheap or expensive without checking.
They check the pictures, the amount of fruit, and the order instead of trusting color alone.
攤主、顧客和瑜瑜把兩張卡片並排比較。
他們核對圖案、份量和訂單，不只憑顏色判斷。

scenes.title: Agree on the match

C: After each person explains what they see, the customer and worker agree on the same matching card.
Gail helps them check, but the decision is theirs.
每個人都說出自己的觀察後，顧客與攤主選了同一張相符卡片。
瑜瑜協助核對，決定仍由雙方作出。

scenes.title: Put the signs back

C: One by one, the workers replace the price cards above the right baskets.
They also clear the walkway so customers can see each stall.
攤主逐張把價牌掛回正確的果籃上方。
他們也清出走道，讓顧客能看清每個攤位。

scenes.title: A fair payment

C: Now that both sides can see the same card, the customer pays the agreed price.
The worker receives the coin and hands him the fresh fruit.
雙方都能看見相同的價牌後，顧客按約定價格付款。
攤主收下代幣，把新鮮水果交給他。

scenes.title: The market opens

C: With the price cards back in place, the worker asks Gail, “Would you like beef or pork with your rice and salad?”
Gail chooses beef and checks the price before she buys her meal; friendly trade fills the market once more.
價牌都歸位後，攤主問瑜瑜：「妳的白飯和沙拉要配牛肉，還是豬肉？」
瑜瑜選了牛肉，買餐點前先確認價格；市集再次充滿友善的交易聲。

scenes.title: A golden goodbye

C: The worker thanks Gail for helping everyone ask and check rather than guess.
After they say goodbye, the golden token lights a path home.
攤主感謝瑜瑜幫大家先問、先查，而不是猜測。
她們道別後，金色代幣才亮起回家的路。

scenes.title: Back in the bedroom

C: Back in her familiar bedroom, Gail sets the still token on the table.
She remembers that a fair choice begins with looking carefully and asking the people involved.
回到熟悉的臥室，瑜瑜把停穩的代幣放在桌上。
她記得，公平的選擇從仔細看、向相關的人問清楚開始。
